counter_capacity_note: Conservative test at the reported minimum of four concurrent workers; not a maximum established by measurement.
default_capacity_note: Two-person access is reported for morcilla and retained for potato; two for other trays is an editable assumption.
notes: Lateral reach is ±0.5 m along the six-tray counter; it is not a 0.5 m circular radius through fixtures.
Standing bands are projected onto the current fixture-clear simulation grid. Depth/offset and capacities require field validation.
Cutting remains one shared resource; this policy does not create extra cutting boards.
Choose an available ingredient in the same order before waiting. If none are available, wait where the worker last worked.
